source_build: ACNH main.elf from the locally extracted game build; same RomFS/ExeFS corpus used by the static UI analysis

method.factory_criterion: 336-byte raw-ELF function with decompilation, one allocation-size literal, and direct calls to raw targets 0x1da8210, 0x1144600, and 0x1da8220 (Ghidra function labels FUN_01ea8210, FUN_01244600, and FUN_01ea8220); the remaining non-generic direct-call target is the constructor.
method.class_name_source: The unique distinct string reference containing Page in each factory function.
method.vptr_resolution: Constructor stores a relocated global plus 0x10 into the object vptr. The decompiler pseudo-global address maps to the ELF relocation slot by subtracting 0x100000; the R_AARCH64_RELATIVE target plus 0x10 is the observed address point.
method.pointer_entry_count_limit: Count is the contiguous relocated code-pointer sequence recorded at the observed address point. This gives its extent in the existing extraction, but individual C++ method meanings and page lifecycle roles are not implied.

limits: Factory registration is proven; global show/hide/back/modal stack order and focus restoration are not established by this catalog.
A class-name string and vtable do not prove which BFLYT/BFLAN asset the page loads. Page-to-layout ownership remains unproven unless another direct native edge or runtime observation establishes it.
The pointer-sequence entry count is structural evidence only; most virtual slots still lack behavior labels.
